dataset_facts.nature: Synthetic feature-engineered bank-account-opening applications, generated from CTGAN trained on anonymized real-world application data. This is not raw transaction data or live customer data.
dataset_facts.scope: Only Base variant is used in this project. Each official variant has 1,000,000 rows; the suite has Base plus 5 variants.

month.meaning: Eight consecutive application-month indices. These are not literal calendar months 0 to 7. Paper says original observations span February through September, but the synthetic month index should be reported as relative M1 to M8.

dataset_facts.income: Annual income represented in decile form; not an actual currency amount.
dataset_facts.customer_age: Applicant age rounded to the decade in the published data; protected age group cannot recover exact real applicant age.

do_not_globally_replace_negatives.velocity_6h: Datasheet gives a valid published range starting at -175; no missing sentinel is documented. Negative values may reflect the synthetic generation/noise.
do_not_globally_replace_negatives.credit_risk_score: Datasheet gives range [-191,389]; negative scores are not documented missing sentinels.

missing_value_policy.implementation_advice: Convert only documented sentinels to NaN, keep per-column missing indicators, fit any numeric imputers and scalers only on train. Count both native nulls and documented encoded missingness in EDA.
missing_value_policy.documentation_caveat: Datasheet Q9 says no information is missing, but field-level Q7 explicitly documents missing sentinels. Field-level sentinel definitions should take precedence for cleaning.

metrics_and_fairness.operating_point: Paper uses TPR (recall) at 5% FPR, where FPR=FP/(FP+TN), not 5% of all applications flagged.
metrics_and_fairness.validation_threshold: For this project, select thresholds on month index 6 only and freeze before evaluating month index 7. Test FPR is measured, not forced back to 5%.
metrics_and_fairness.paper_reproduction_caveat: Official notebook computes ROC and chooses the 5% FPR threshold using test labels, a descriptive oracle operating point. This should not be copied for an honest held-out deployment-threshold estimate.
metrics_and_fairness.alert_budget: 5% FPR and 5% total alert rate are different constraints. Equal-alert-budget model-versus-rule comparisons require a separate threshold frozen from validation.
metrics_and_fairness.age_group_primary: Younger <50 and Older >=50, supported by datasheet Q17 and official empirical_results.ipynb.
metrics_and_fairness.age_boundary_discrepancy: Paper section 3.2 instead states <=50 versus >50. Because age is rounded to decades, a sensitivity comparison is useful and the chosen boundary must be explicit.
metrics_and_fairness.paper_fairness_metric: min(group FPR)/max(group FPR), with 1 meaning parity; also report signed FPR gap in percentage points and each denominator.
metrics_and_fairness.pr_auc: State whether PR-AUC means sklearn average_precision_score (step-weighted AP) or trapezoidal integral; do not mix definitions.
metrics_and_fairness.threshold_ties: ROC thresholds classify scores >= threshold. Official notebook later uses > threshold; use a consistent comparator and recompute confusion matrices to avoid tied-score inconsistencies.

other_pitfalls: The official README example pd.read_csv(index_col=0) is not universally safe. Inspect the actual downloaded header and preserve fraud_bool; drop only a proven export-index column.

Data is synthetic and the rows are independently generated: month enables temporal evaluation but no within-month ordering, applicant linkage, event replay, or real streaming window recomputation can be recovered.

month is available at scoring but represents an extrapolating time index. Treat it as a split variable and exclude from primary model inputs; a training-only/validation-only ablation can examine sensitivity.
The velocity features represent average application volume per hour over their windows, not necessarily a count associated with the same applicant.
Do not infer meanings of anonymized category codes such as payment_type or employment_status.
Some names in the datasheet predate the released schema: device_distinct_emails corresponds to released device_distinct_emails_8w.
Protected age in model inputs is an explicit modeling decision; report whether it is included. Removing age alone does not guarantee equal FPR because other features may be proxies.
Business review workloads, monetary savings, and real production deployment are hypothetical: the dataset lacks verified investigation costs and fraud loss amounts.
